title: Pramati Educational & Cultural Trust v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Pramati Educational & Cultural Trust v. Union of India, (2014) 8 SCC 1
content.holding: The Constitution Bench considered Article 15(5) and the application of the RTE framework to minority educational institutions and held that the RTE regime could not be applied in a way that infringes Article 30(1).
content.relevance: Key authority on Article 15(5), minority institutions and RTE.
